hold_text: Edits the self-landing work-store-export workflow's validation step and its pre-check; the manager merges and re-dispatches the export.
why: WHY: EXPORT-VALIDATION-GAP. The first work-store export run (44648031388, 11-20 00:42Z) validated with 5 named guards plus tests/test_checklist*/test_pipeline*/test_work*, passed, and its bot PR #27549 went red in full CI: redate-guard refused 13 exported pipeline records, and tests/console_connector/test_tabs.py::test_inbox_items_carry_options_key asserted the LIVE register held an open operator_decision edge (the last one, DESK-18D-JUDGE-2, was unblocked in the store on 11-17). WHAT (manager decision 01:10Z): (a) the export pre-check also runs pipeline.redate_problems (the redate-guard's own predicate), holding back and filing a failing record like the other three guards, and redate-guard now skips export-stamped pre-cutover files (work_export_cutover.exempt_paths). The 0001-01-01 in 6 refusals is NOT a serialisation sentinel: it is pipeline.next_due_date's own date.min for a prior record with no last_checked; the store later set last_checked without a redate block, before the 11-19 22:30Z cutover, so it is pre-cutover debt. All 13 refused records carry pre-cutover stamps. (b) validation runs scripts/ci/run_guards.py in relevance mode on the export diff (exactly the set CI's PR guards job selects) and pytest over every register-reading test file derived by the new scripts/ci/register_reader_tests.py; checkout is fetch-depth 0 as in guards.yml; job timeout 100 -> 150. (c) the inbox test uses a fixture register; a second test checks the live register's shape even when it holds no decisions. Gates this adds or changes: none (producer-side validation of its own output; narrows redate to skip pre-cutover export debt).
